symbols.meaning: The spirit of spring and wild creative life, before any form or rule.
Energy in constant motion: the whirl of creation.
Primal instinct and the dangers of the unknown, which he meets without fear.
Love, death and transformation accompanying the leap.
Ecstasy, intoxication and the joy of the god of wine.
Mercury: communication, speed and intelligence.
The instruments of creation kept in motion by will.
Balance of opposing forces and the power of healing words.
The shadow of intelligence: imitation, trickery and lies.
Pure spiritual light, hidden from casual sight.
The huntress moon and the arrow of intuition.
The journey across the desert to the source of wisdom.
The beginnings of life and form in the world below.
Selfless, nurturing love.
Spiritual beauty opening into the world.
Creative fire moving through love.
Power that sees in two directions; protection of what she creates.
Aries: drive, initiative and raw masculine energy.
Power tempered by peace and gentleness.
Industry and organized power.
The figure four: order and stability.
The new spiritual truth being born within the old teaching.
Taurus: patience and the earthy foundation of tradition.
Active spiritual force, protecting the teaching.
Strength, memory and steady wisdom.
The hermit priest who performs the alchemical marriage.
Opposites to be united: sun and moon, active and receptive.
Love that acts beyond reason.
The new life that comes from union.
The sacred thing he carries and protects.
The four elements combined and harnessed.
Inner calm at the heart of forward movement.
The protection of the heavens over the quest.
Ecstatic union with instinct rather than control over it.
The many passions and instincts of life, all ridden at once.
Life force offered up in joy.
In the Thoth deck Lust is eleven, the number of magical energy.
The inner light of wisdom.
Fertility of the mind and the ripened harvest of experience.
Life hidden and waiting to be born.
The guardian of the underworld, tamed and following.
The turning of fortune and the cycles of life.
Balance and wisdom riding the crest.
The ups and downs that come to everyone.
Sudden changes from forces beyond control.
Perfect, delicate balance that must be kept by constant adjustment.
The cutting edge of truth.
All things weighed, from beginning to end.
The ordered framework of cause and effect.
In the Thoth deck Adjustment is eight.
Life itself suspends him; surrender as a path to new life.
Sacrifice and being held still.
The fixed structure of the old way, about to change.
The beginning and end of a cycle, renewal.
Death as a ruler of transformation.
New life forms born as the old is cut.
The three faces of Scorpio: death, regeneration and rising above.
Life in the deep waters, continuing beyond the ending.
The union of opposites in one being.
The alchemical vessel where change happens.
Combining what seems incompatible.
Fire and water, each taking on the other's color.
Pan: earthy creative energy and laughter.
Insight within the material world.
Creative force channeled through matter.
Life pressing upward from deep within the earth.
Sudden awareness that sees through everything.
Destruction that consumes what is false.
Old forms breaking apart.
Peace and wisdom on the other side of upheaval.
The infinite heavens and boundless possibility.
Solar and lunar forces pouring out together.
Cosmic inspiration moving through all things.
The world held within the heavens.
The gates of the unknown.
Guides and guardians of the threshold of the underworld.
The promise that light will return after the night.
The way through fear and illusion.
Freedom, innocence and joy.
Life-giving light and the flowering of the spirit.
The whole year blessed by the sun.
The earth made fertile; a safe place to dance.
The infinite sky embracing the new era.
The point of energy at the heart of things.
The new consciousness, silent and powerful.
Not a final judgment but the dawn of a new age.
Completion that is alive and in motion.
The energy of life, played with rather than feared.
The whole cosmos as one circle.
The four elements united in the finished work.
